introLines: For DEAHO, loyalty does not end with a single commission.
It begins by understanding the client, preserving the right information,
and keeping a production flow that makes every return easier.
Repeat trust is built through a process that stays stable over time.
copy.quoteBody: Time spent together is the clearest proof.

featureSlides.title: 01. Repeat Trust
featureSlides.body: Clients return not only because the previous result was satisfying, but because the full process remains clear: consultation, design direction, revisions, production, inspection, and delivery. DEAHO keeps the standards and context from each project so the next commission can begin with confidence and move with greater precision.

featureSlides.title: 02. Shared Memory
featureSlides.body: A symbol made once continues to live in the memory of a team or an individual. DEAHO preserves the intention and specifications of previous projects so the next request can continue the same story with consistency.

featureSlides.title: 03. Documented Care
featureSlides.body: Questions after delivery and follow-up requests are part of the relationship. When checks and images are kept as a clear record, the next season or refinement request can move faster and more accurately.

hero.title: CREDIBILITY
hero.subtitle: Trust is not decoration. It is an arrangement of verifiable numbers and relationships.

copy.intro: DEAHO credibility is not explained by experience alone. From design consultation to production, inspection, and delivery, every stage is managed directly so important group projects can be completed within clear standards and schedules.

rows.title: 38 years of craft
rows.accent: A standard that does not drift
paragraphs: Since 1988, DEAHO has specialized in championship rings, commission rings, and group commemorative products for sports teams, military organizations, schools, institutions, and companies.
This experience is not only a matter of time. It is a record of solving real production variables such as event schedules, symbols, engraving, quantities, and delivery methods.

rows.title: 100% in-house process control
rows.accent: Managed directly from design to delivery
paragraphs: DEAHO manages design, 3D planning, casting, finishing, stone setting, engraving, surface treatment, inspection, and packing under one production standard.
This reduces variables in quality, design intent, and schedule control, especially for group orders with many details to verify.

rows.title: 0% delivery incidents
paragraphs: Projects tied to ceremonies and official events require reliable delivery as much as product quality.
DEAHO treats schedule management as part of production, planning confirmation, sizing, engraving, inspection, packing, and shipping around the client’s event date.

rows.title: Group order management system
rows.accent: Names, sizes, and engraving tracked accurately
paragraphs: Group production requires accurate handling of names, sizes, engraving, quantities, and packing formats for every recipient.
DEAHO organizes individual data from the production stage and checks it through final delivery.

rows.title: Continuous R&D
paragraphs: DEAHO’s research and development is focused on stable quality, accurate production, and better results across materials, casting, finishing, engraving, surface treatment, and setting.
Continuous improvement helps reduce error and strengthens the standard clients can trust.

rows.title: Quality inspection standard
paragraphs: Quality is not judged only by appearance. Surface finish, engraving clarity, setting stability, proportions, comfort, sizing, and package condition must all be checked.
Before delivery, DEAHO reviews the product details, function, and packaging so clients can receive the final result with confidence.

hero.title: ACHIEVEMENT
hero.subtitle: Recognition and notable moments are kept as records filled with light.

introLines: DEAHO achievements are not simple production quantities.
They are records of leadership in championship and commission rings,
first domestic applications, and repeated projects that shaped
the standard for commemorative ring production.
copy.quoteBody: The records DEAHO built became industry standards.
copy.marketIntro:
DEAHO market share is not only a number. It is the result of trust built over time. Products that commemorate important moments, such as championship rings and commission rings, are chosen only when design completion, production stability, delivery control, and inspection standards are all met.
By completing projects for many teams and institutions, DEAHO continues to build one of the most trusted production standards in Korea.

privacy.intro: DAEHO (the “Company”) complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and other applicable laws, and establishes and discloses the following Privacy Policy to protect users’ personal information and to promptly handle related concerns.

sections.heading: Article 1 (Purposes of Processing)
body: The Company processes personal information for the following purposes and does not use it for any purpose other than those stated:
1. Receiving and responding to production and order inquiries
2. Identity verification, contact, and consultation
3. Service provision and quality improvement

sections.heading: Article 2 (Items of Personal Information Processed)
body: 1. When receiving inquiries: name, contact details (phone number, email), and inquiry content
2. Information generated and collected automatically during use: access IP, cookies, service usage records, and device information

sections.heading: Article 3 (Processing and Retention Period)
body: The Company processes and retains personal information within the retention period required by law or consented to by the user.
1. Inquiry records: retained for [ ] year(s) after the purpose is achieved, then destroyed

2. Where retention is required by law, information is kept for the applicable period (e.g., records on consumer complaints or dispute handling for 3 years under the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce).

sections.heading: Article 4 (Provision to Third Parties)
body: As a rule, the Company does not provide users’ personal information to third parties. It may do so only with the user’s prior consent or where specifically required by law.

sections.heading: Article 5 (Outsourcing of Processing)
body: Where necessary for smooth service provision, the Company may outsource personal-information processing. In such cases it discloses the trustee and the outsourced work in this Policy and supervises the trustee in accordance with applicable laws.

sections.heading: Article 6 (Rights of Data Subjects and How to Exercise Them)
body: Users may at any time request access to, correction or deletion of, or suspension of processing of their personal information, and the Company will act without delay in accordance with applicable laws.
Rights may be exercised by contacting the Privacy Officer in writing, by phone, or by email, and the Company will act after verifying the requester’s identity.

sections.heading: Article 7 (Destruction of Personal Information)
body: When the retention period expires or the purpose of processing is achieved, the Company destroys the personal information without delay. Electronic files are deleted by irrecoverable means, and paper documents are shredded or incinerated.

sections.heading: Article 8 (Measures to Ensure Security)
body: The Company takes administrative, technical, and physical measures to ensure the security of personal information.
These include managing access privileges, operating access-control systems, encrypting personal information, and installing and reviewing security programs.

sections.heading: Article 9 (Cookies)
body: The Company may use cookies to provide customized services.
Users may refuse the storage of cookies through their web browser settings; refusing cookies may limit the use of some services.

sections.heading: Article 10 (Privacy Officer)

· Privacy Officer: [Name] / [Title]
· Contact: [Phone], [Email]
